sources.title: Filesystem sandbox escape when paths or symlinks contain trailing slashes
sources.version_or_commit: Advisory GHSA-vqjp-4c8c-hfgg, published 2026-08-20; patch versions 24.0.13, 36.0.14, 46.0.3, 47.0.4; 48.0.0+ reported unaffected.
sources.locator: Affected/patched versions, impact, Linux openat2 condition, patch/workaround.
sources.observed_operation: Official GitHub security advisory opened; affected versions and impact read.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Trailing slash/symlink paths could escape WASI filesystem sandbox on affected releases; specific issue not present with Linux kernel >5.6 using openat2, while macOS/older Linux are affected.
sources.applicability: Requires patch/version monitoring and symlink/trailing-slash cross-platform regression tests; do not infer that capability APIs eliminate path bugs.

sources.title: Guest-controlled resource exhaustion in WASI implementations
sources.locator: Impact; WASIp1/WASIp2; host memory, handles, I/O buffers; default limit behavior by release.
sources.observed_operation: Official advisory opened; affected versions, host API pathways, patch caveat read.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Guest-controlled host allocations/buffering could exhaust memory or crash; older patched stable branches kept limits very large by default; 42.0.0+ defaults were tuned to avoid the reported issue.
sources.applicability: Bound host-call data, buffers, handles, output, and disk separately; runtime patch alone may not select safe embedder quotas.

sources.title: Excessive allocated memory on the host when guests don't have stdio
sources.locator: Affected versions and patches; Impact; workaround; WASI Preview 2 SinkOutputStream, write-zeroes and stdout/stderr configuration (captured page lines 139–158).
sources.observed_operation: Official GitHub security advisory opened; full affected ranges, condition, patch list and bounded OutputStream workaround inspected.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The wasmtime-wasi WASI Preview 2 SinkOutputStream used by default when stdout/stderr are unconfigured failed to limit a write-zeroes allocation. Affected: <36.0.17, 37.0.0–48.0.3, 49.0.0–49.0.1. Patched: 36.0.17, 48.0.4, 49.0.2. Configured stdout/stderr streams typically have limits; custom OutputStream with bounded check_write is a workaround.
sources.applicability: Only applies to embeddings without configured stdout/stderr using the affected wasmtime-wasi paths; require bounded output streams and test this default explicitly if Wasmtime/WASIp2 is selected.
